title: Merged expert clusters to logical member code bank
hypothesis: Routing-weighted merged expert centers plus compact member Views recover cluster members at fewer complete bytes than independent expert checkpoints, with private residual demand rising under heterogeneity.
physical_object: routing-weighted dominant expert center per cluster
mirror_coordinate: member-specific coefficients over a shared residual basis
logical_multiplicity: 32 member experts reconstructed from eight merged centers
controls: native PCA coefficients over shared residual basis

development.selection_metric: heldout member output nRMSE, router-weighted error, actual bytes and reconstruction MAC

fresh.reason: Mirror and native PCA payload/function aliases are assessed before fresh access

storage.authority: actual compressed NPZ inference payload bytes

success_gate: A shared code bank has heldout nRMSE <=0.02, >=25% fewer complete bytes than independent members, and beats native PCA/low-rank controls at equal bytes and compute.
failure_gate: FAIL for Mirror specificity if native PCA matches the payload/function, or private residual demand erases savings at the quality gate.
boundaries: Synthetic linear expert checkpoints and known routing frequencies only; no trained M-SMoE/MC-SMoE or end-task MoE score.
Routing frequencies are generated from a Zipf-like synthetic distribution and included in paid state.
Member weights are available to the compressor; heldout members are used only for reconstruction scoring.
